title: Black-Cap

inlines.v: BLACK-CAP, noun [black and cap.] A bird, the Motacilla atricapilla, or mock-nightingale; so called from its black crown. It is common in Europe. 1. In cookery, an apple roasted till black, to be served up in a dish of boiled custard. BLACK'-CATTLE, noun [black and cattle.] Cattle of the bovine genus, as bulls, oxen and cows. [English.]
